item.title: RSS is pretty good
item.description:
What is RSS?

RSS stands for Really Simple Syndication. its main use is for getting updates from websites that use RSS in one nice app. For example: blogs (like mine), news, youtube, etc,.

Where to find RSS

Most blogs will have an RSS link on their page. If you copy the link on the RSS button on my website and paste it into your favorite feed app, you now have a nice way to get updates on my website without having to search for it on your browser.

Sometimes it isn’t really that easy and you will have to look a little bit. Fret not, I have two links to save the day.

One is a youtube RSS link, if you take the link and put your favorite youtuber’s channel ID at the end of the link, you now have a feed. The way to find your youtuber’s channel ID is to go on their page, click “more” right above the subscribe button, share channel and then copy channel ID. Every youtuber has a unique channel ID that is a bunch of random letters and numbers.

Two is a RSS finder website, you put the website’s link you want a RSS for and it finds it for you. In some cases, websites will just straight up not have a feed for you to grab.

What app to use?

Honestly it is up to you. I can only recommend two in my opinion. One is NetNewsWire which is really nice to use on MacOS and iOS. Two is Mutt if you want RSS feeds in the terminal, it does take some setup though.

Why bother?

Nowadays people are spoon-fed content and endlessly consume things they really hate or will inevitably forget. With RSS you most likely will still consume endlessly, but at least you have the choice of what you want to see.

It is also a nice way to avoid the news – lets be honest humans have a negativity bias, and news outlets abuse that constantly. You can also be fed propaganda on news sites.

With youtube, well youtube is designed to be very addictive and hook users in.

Stop consuming slop and things you hate. It is important that we are intentional with what we expose ourselves in a day and age of endless content and information.

item.title: Is Linux the Perfect OS?
item.description:
It’s better than most OSes

Windows has to be one of the worse operating systems on the market. You are fed updates constantly when you don’t want nor need them, it is uncustomizable, sluggishly slow and you have zero privacy whatsoever.

Windows 11 has to be one of the most unusable and privacy invasive OS I have ever used. Now here is a story: I had to use windows 11 one time on a relative’s computer, and it was a miserable experience. I can’t really explain it in a good and concise way, but trying to use windows 11 is like trying to do a handstand when you don’t need to. File explorer has somehow gotten worse and more confusing despite it being the most important app on any OS.

MacOS is a pretty okay OS, since it is well known that MacOS is based on FreeBSD afterall lmao. Even with that fact in mind, MacOS is very restricting and treats its users like toddlers. You can’t really customize MacOS the way you want to, you can only get what apple gives you.

The M-series chips although impressive, is stifled by a bad OS. Can you imagine just how insane the M-series chips would be if you can actually use it to play any game or use any OS? With how unstable MacOS is and undocumented the M-series chips are, it will never be good for those kind of things.

MacOS and Macbooks are smart-person proof

My story

I was honestly quite sad that windows 10 was going to be unsupported a few years ago and I started looking into linux.

Which was a really good decision despite whatever problems I was dealing with. I got into it in the first place since I heard it has good privacy and you can customize it to your heart’s content.

Seriously it is amazing just how customizable linux is. Look at r/unixporn for example for a few minutes.

The best part about linux is the Free and Open-Source Software. Maybe if you aren’t a programmer it doesn’t matter. But keep in mind that MacOS, Windows and its programs are closed-source. You have no idea what programs you are running on your own computer nor can you check the code or modify it.

But is linux perfect?

No not really. A perfect OS would be something like TempleOS or FreeBSD

The problem with linux is that if you’re someone who doesn’t care about computers, you are gonna have a bad time. It is cause trying to use linux takes patience to use and understand. There are also so many distros, it is hard to pick one if you’re starting out. (sidenote: on picking a distro… a beginner should start with linux mint, and if you’re are experienced use artix linux. [sidesidenote: please for the love of god do NOT use ubuntu])

Linux is an amalgamation of GNU utilities and allot of other programs. Allot of other OSes don’t really have this unique problem.

But if all of that doesn’t really bother than you… then yes! linux is perfect. You can game, program, customize it, etc,. The sky’s the limit with Linux.

Linux teaches you that you have control over your computer. These companies should not decide what you do with things you own.

About gaming

You’d be surprised just how many of your favorite games can run on linux comfortably. Yes, maybe there will be some hiccups if you are using a compatibility layer like proton or playing a badly optimized “native” game (looking at you valve).

If you are curious about that check out ProtonDB. ProtonDB documents so many games on steam whether or not if it works on steamdeck or a desktop linux experiences.

About programming

Using linux has gotten me into using vim (its a text editor in the terminal). It has changed the way I program and do certain things even when using a MacBook.

Linux has to be one of the greatest havens for a programmer.

item.title: I loathe AI
item.description:
My views on AI

In my personal opinion I believe AI is pretty overhyped and is something that shouldn’t be used to the extent it is used nowadays.

Of course there are plenty of better articles that give reasons why AI is bad, but for my sanity I won’t go that deep on those things. I will give a couple of links in case you are interested.

And me personally I never want to touch any LLM in my life ever again, I used it allot when it started out fresh. But began to despise it the more and more I used it.

Overhyped

I find it strange that so many of my friends and family are so interested in AI in the first place. In my eyes there is nothing special about AI.

They tell me “Use it! Everyone uses it.” directly or indirectly.

Do we really need to follow this hype train? Seriously? Its like people are afraid of getting left behind by not using this technology, but they should be happy that they are not using this.

“Benefits”

There are so many benefits to not using AI, and very little to gain from using AI. Cause lets be honest… What benefits is a normal person getting compared to a AI monolith company? Even if you aren’t paying a single cent to these AI companies, I hope people are aware of the fact that their chats are 100% recorded.

“But what about for productivity?”- Who cares? It doesn’t really matter to be honest, productivity is just a measurement used by idiots.

Dehumanization

AI is used to take everything great about humanity and puts something that isn’t worth being amazed at.

It takes the soul out of people’s eyes when it used in pictures. It takes the craft of art and replaces it with something that has no emotion.

I just find it sad and frustrating that people use these AI models for pictures and art that they can very much do themselves, despite how much they secretly doubt themselves.

I would say bad and messy art has more merit than whatever concoction AI generated images are.

“Look I made this xyz thing using AI”

No you didn’t. You didn’t make it.

My notes

I actually made a draft similar to article but when I first took a second to read and understand what I typed out… It was very emotional and argumentative to say the very least.

It frustrates me how people are still mentally in the AI bubble, especially those close to me.

Maybe it will change in the future. But who knows :)

In my opinion its probably better to live your life without AI.
